Hiryu Custom - Interior
Yesterday and today, we've been cruising normally@off the Transition Route. What happened to the@interplanetary transition test?
We've been attacked twice, so maybe they're@reviewing the plan and the itinerary?
While drifting on inertia for two whole days?@If they're observing the destination, that's@taking way too long.
True...
Besides, the moment we left the Transition Route,@the test voyage lost its meaning.
Exactly.
Kind of late to be asking, but does this voyage@even have a real destination?
Now that you mention it, they didn't really@explain it at the briefing either...
Either there's no need to,@or there's a reason they can't explain...
And the briefing wasn't before departure,@it was after we'd reached orbit...@Was that because we were in a hurry?
Yeah, it felt like every second counted.
But now we're leisurely drifting on inertia.@Including the destination thing, don't you@think it's strange?
Hmm... Now that you mention it, sure.@But I'd just accepted that this is@that kind of mission.
Same here.
I'm not a soldier, so that doesn't cut it for me.@I want to know the real reason I was called@in for this mission.
Oh, my <D-Con>... It's a summons.
A briefing now...?
Maybe we'll finally get answers to our questions...
I hope so.
Hiryu Custom - Briefing Room
Miles
This ship is scheduled to reach the target area@after about three hours of normal cruising.
Yes, I know what you're all wondering.@Until now, we haven't stated the destination@of this voyage.
This ship has traveled beyond Mars's orbit@to test the space transition device,@and that is no lie.
However, this voyage has another purpose.@That is... the honorable mission of escorting@an envoy for peace negotiations.
Peace negotiations...?
Out here? With who?
Tsugumi
It can't be...
The envoy will negotiate not with Earthlings, nor@with <Balmar> or the <Zovorg>, but with aliens who@are unrelated to them and newly arrived here.
They call themselves the Gadisword.
...I knew there was more to it.
Making contact with a new alien race...
If it's a negotiation, they must be able@to communicate through language.
Are they humanoid intelligent beings,@like us...?
If they're the ones who proposed negotiations,@they may have analyzed our language.
So, is it a pattern like the Zovorg?
But the Commander did say peace negotiations.
If that's true, it'd be a rare case@of first contact, hmm?
Matters concerning the Gadisword are top secret,@so we had to keep them from you until now.
Shortly, this ship will make contact with@the artificial celestial body Rabulpaila,@which we believe to be their base.
As this is a preliminary peace negotiation, combat@is not very likely, but do not forget your duty@to be prepared for the unexpected.
I also expect you all to exercise care@not to cause needless friction@with the Gadisword.
...Combat is not very likely, huh?@That's a delicate way to put it.
Could the reason we were called in be...
They likely needed high-performance units@that excel at space combat, just in case.
...The same reason the Alterion@was fitted with weapons.
(To be ready for encounters with hostile@intelligent life in outer space, huh...?)
(Will we end up at war with@the Gadisword too...?)
All engines stop. We'll contact the Gadisword.@All hands, remain at level one battle stations.
Captain, launch the mobile units and have them@accompany the ship.
Bryan
Commander Miles, I'd rather you didn't.@It would intimidate our negotiating partners.
I can't accept that, even from you, Your@Excellency. We wouldn't be able to respond@quickly if something happened.
I trust the Hiryu Custom's crew would manage@anyway. Just like when they rescued me@when I was taken hostage during the DC War.
...I cannot agree to that.
Then let me put it this way. Entering with@a drawn sword can be seen as a sign of fear.@Especially for a commander.
Hm...
It's to help the negotiations go smoothly. Please.
If you insist, very well.@Captain, belay my previous order.
Roger.
Put Rabulpaila on the main screen@at maximum magnification.
Eun
Roger.@Displaying Rabulpaila at maximum magnification.
Hmm... Quite an imposing appearance.
Sean
It's more a fortress than a spaceship. Judging from@the structures on top, their science and technology@seem similar to ours.
The question is whose level is higher.
I hope we're talking about diplomacy.
What's on the underside of Rabulpaila...@some kind of launcher? A mass driver, perhaps?
That caliber... If it's a weapon,@it must be quite powerful.
Take care not to enter its line of fire.@Are the Gadisword deploying anything@resembling mobile weapons?
No signals at this time.
It seems they know their manners.
Then hail them.
Roger.@...To Rabulpaila Control. This is the Earth@Federation Army multipurpose battleship Hiryu Custom.
Sending message based on the translation protocol@you provided. Please report reception status.
I repeat.@This is the Earth Federation Army multipurpose@battleship Hiryu Custom. Please report reception.
...This is Rabulpaila Control.@Hiryu Custom, we read you loud and clear.
We are carrying an Earth Federation Government@envoy and cruising on inertia. Please indicate@the format and location of the negotiations.
Operator
The negotiations will take place in a conference@room within Rabulpaila. The Gadisword's ruler,@Head Chief Malum Quisude, will receive you.
...So it's an invitation.
We have too little information about them right now.@Let's push to hold the negotiations aboard this ship.
No, there's no need.@I want to see the inside of Rabulpaila myself.
I want to know what kind of culture the Gadisword@have. To help move the negotiations forward.
But we can't trust them yet. Besides, our mission@includes ensuring your safety,@Your Excellency.
If anything happens to me, things move to another@stage. That might actually suit the government and@military better. It would leave no loose ends.
That's not...
No. In that sense, I'm something of a pawn.@That's why I want to do everything I can now.@To avoid the worst-case scenario.
...Understood. Myself, Lieutenant Yon Jevana and@a squad of marines will accompany you,@Your Excellency.
Yon Jevana...? Ah, I see.@Because she's skilled at contact with aliens.
That's right.
Well then, I'm counting on you.
Yes, sir.@Captain, prepare a shuttle.
Rabulpaila - Interior
Malum
...I see. So they've answered us.
Herluga
That said, it seems they'll leave their mothership@waiting outside and enter port in a small craft.@Evidently they don't trust us completely.
Naturally.@This is first contact with an alien civilization.
Are you really sure about this? As the one in@charge, I have more than a few reservations about@inviting aliens into Rabulpaila.
They're a major power with a population in the@billions. We must strive to earn their trust.
(Typical thinking from the Minister of Environmental@Development. As if an equal peace were possible with@so overwhelming a gap. And they're aliens, no less.)
By the way, is there still no word@on Fairy Klibia's whereabouts?
Reggiane
It's certain she crashed on Earth...@but what happened after that is still unknown.
Then I suppose we have no choice but to ask@the Earthlings to hand her over...
There's no need. It would only give them@unnecessary information.
But I still can't believe it.@That Fairy, the woman who served as my bodyguard,@would plot a rebellion...
Under the present circumstances, that's an@unforgivable crime... She should be disposed of@on the spot as soon as she's found.
No, no, that won't do.@I want to hear her reasons from her directly.
...That's enough talk.@Let's go greet the Earth delegation, Head Chief.
Y-Yes, very well.
...So this is where we'll negotiate.@I was hoping to see some Gadisword furnishings@and works of art.
As expected, Rabulpaila must be some kind of space@fortress. I saw what looked like facilities for@operating weapons and mobile weapons.
So it's bleak because it's a military facility?@Lieutenant Yon, what's your view?
Judging from Rabulpaila's interior and the people@and machinery I saw on the way in, I'd say they're@a race very close to us in many respects.
They seem to have the same two sexes, too.@Is that coincidence or inevitability...?
Welcome to Rabulpaila.@I am Malum Quisude, Head Chief of the Gadisword.
I am Herluga Isberga, in charge of Rabulpaila.
Thank you for the gracious welcome. I am Bryan@Midcrid, envoy of the Earth Federation Government.@And this is the head of my retinue...
Brigadier General Miles Boothroyd, Commander of the@1st Independent Special Task Force, under the Earth@Federation Army's Joint Chiefs of Staff.
I'm Lieutenant Yon Jevana. I've been dispatched@to Earth from the Interstellar Republic Alliance,@the <Zovorg>.
Hmm...
I-Interstellar Republic Alliance...?@Th-Then you've already made contact@with an alien civilization...?
The mere fact that we breathe the same air as you@and can hold a conversation amazes us greatly...@But for a nation spanning the stars to really exist...
Well, well, my... I'm simply astonished.
And you... though it's through a translator,@you understand our language very well.
We've been intercepting your communications for@some time... Using the data we gathered, Director@Herluga built a translator for us.
Hmm... I see.
You seem to have analyzed Earth's languages@in a very short time.
On what basis do you say that?
Ah, well... Director Herluga is a very capable man.@We owe where we are today to him.
Well then, may I ask what brought you@to our solar system..........?
Hiryu Custom Bridge
Captain, Lieutenant Yon has sent a report. She says@they've learned the details of how Rabulpaila came@to the solar system.
Give me the summary.
Understood.@Let me skim through the report, then...
The Gadisword were split into several factions in@a long civil war... and apparently Rabulpaila was@one of the things that helped bring it to an end.
So it has considerable fighting power?
Not only that, it has a space transition device.@Though the device is very large-scale,@so mass production is impossible.
Then it seems they haven't reached@the Zovorg's level of technology.
Most likely.
Please, go on.
After the civil war ended, the planet Gadisword@was suddenly attacked by a group@of unidentified mobile weapons.
Rabulpaila's people speculate they were new@weapons another faction built that ran amok in@an accident, or perhaps alien invasion weapons...
They threw the entire planet Gadisword into chaos,@and as a result, many lives and cities were lost.
Amid that, the spaceship Malum Quisude was aboard@was attacked, and he had to take refuge in Rabulpaila,@which was on a war footing. And then...
Rabulpaila attempted a space transition to defend@the capital... but the device went out of control,@and we ended up in your star system.
...I see.
(To come to the solar system in a single transition@from a star system so far away that even the Zovorg@don't know where it is...)
(Either their space transition device is special,@or some kind of force was at work...@Either way, that's not normally possible.)
I understand your story well.@You didn't come to the solar system@of your own will.
Yes.@And we have no intention of fighting you.@That is why we proposed peace negotiations.
I believe that was the wisest decision@for both Earth and the Gadisword.
I'd like to ask one thing.@You must also have had the option@of leaving the solar system, no?
Rabulpaila's propulsion system and space transition@device are badly damaged, and they cannot be@repaired with our stockpiled supplies alone.
I see. So that's why Rabulpaila is currently@on a trajectory falling toward the sun.
Yes... Unless we repair the propulsion system and@change course, Rabulpaila will be swallowed@by the star.
Then allow me to confirm...@You have three requests.
Permission to stay in the solar system, refugee status@with the Earth Federation Government, and materials@to fix Rabulpaila's propulsion and transition devices.
Yes. We humbly ask for your assistance.
(Refugee status, huh...@In short, they want us to supply materials for free.)
(Then again, one fortress against the entire Earth@Sphere... With such a gap in strength, I doubt@they could do anything.)
...Will the Earth Federation Government@accept the Gadisword's requests?
There's also the option of foisting them off on the@Zovorg, Rabulpaila and all. They're far better@than us at dealing with aliens.
Then the reason the Commander took@Lieutenant Yon with him...
Perhaps he had orders to that effect@from above.
Multiple gravity quake readings! 3 o'clock,@depression 10! Something seems to be@transitioning in!
The <Zovorg>...!
Were we followed, or...
We'll intercept! All mobile units, launch at once!
Are you sure you don't want to ask@the Commander for instructions?
I'll report, but there's no time to wait for@instructions. Depending on how we respond, they@might think we're in league with the Zovorg.
Iradoya
Well, well, let's stir things up!@Come on, everyone, let's go~!
Zovorg units are firing on us and Rabulpaila!
The Gadisword are their enemies too...?!@Return fire at once!
Inside the Rabulpaila
Wh-What...?!
This tremor is...!
(An explosion...?!)
R-Report the situation!
Numerous unidentified mobile weapons have appeared@in the surrounding area. They attacked Rabulpaila@and the Earth military's ship.
U-Unidentified?!
Sir, we believe they're not Earth military.
...I just received a report from my ship.@The enemies are Zovorg mobile weapons.
What is the meaning of this? Explain yourself.
...My apologies.@There are a small number of people in the Zovorg@who don't follow the central government's will.
B-But why would they@attack Rabulpaila...?!
Because an Earth military ship was in contact with@us. We got caught in the crossfire... No, perhaps@that's not necessarily so.
Hm...@Leave intercepting the enemy to us.@We'll prove we're not in league with them.
Then we'll send interceptors from our side too.@However, given our dire situation, we can't@send very many.
Are you sure about this?
Yes, we'll prove ourselves as well.
I can't believe the Zovorg showed up here...!
Are they <Golaikunru> too?
Probably.
But it's doubtful whether the Gadisword@are really unknown to them.
Didn't the Zovorg not know@about those guys?
That doesn't mean the Golaikunru don't.@After all, they did show up here.
...! Something's coming out of Rabulpaila.
Hmph, the timing's way too good.@Aren't those unknowns working with@the Earth military behind the scenes?
They attacked the Earth ship too, didn't they?@For now, they're a common enemy.
So those are the Gadisword's mobile weapons...
Their form and size are similar@to a <Personal Trooper>.
They look pretty cool. I like 'em.
The other type is closer to an <Armored Module>.
Yes... Maybe the Gadisword's weapons evolved@along similar lines to Earth's.
Dragon 2 to all units.@The Gadisword have offered to fight alongside us.@Set your IFF to friendly.
Hmm, so they want to see what we can do?
...Hey, big brother.
I told you not to call me that on a mission.
Sorry, Sieg... Shouldn't we say something@to the Earth military?
We're not getting chummy. It's not settled@yet that we can trust them.
...We have to use everything we can,@or we won't survive. Not the way we are now...
I know that without being told.@But I'm not about to cozy up to them.
Oh my, so they've come out too.@But that just makes things easier§
Spiria 0 to all units.@Spread out and destroy the Zovorg units.
Let's go, Sally!@Don't fall behind the Earthlings!
Got it!
Oh my, my, my, to be pushed back this far...@But, but, I did what I came for, so whatever~
Well then, see ya later~
All enemy signals in the area are gone.
Units in need of repair or resupply, return to@the ship at once. All others, maintain strict@all-around vigilance.
...They didn't push very hard, did they?
Yes... It seems they had no intention of@destroying or seizing Rabulpaila.
But it didn't seem like a reconnaissance@in force either.
If they meant to do something to Rabulpaila,@they'd have finished it in the first move.@With a <MAP Weapon> or something.
If they knew where we were headed, you'd think@they'd attack before we met up.
Maybe they meant to interfere with@our contact with the Gadisword?
If we'd transitioned right next to Rabulpaila,@maybe, but we approached by normal cruising.@They had plenty of chances to strike first.
Maybe it was just a meet-and-greet.
Why would they need to do that?
(No... That might actually be right.)
Hmm, the Steel Dragons are as good as they say.@Maybe I'll feel just a little@sorry for Kinaha?
They attacked knowing we were@in contact with the Gadisword?
Heehee, the tension is just overflowing here.
The important people are having an important@talk, so you don't want anyone interrupting, right?
I'd better not overdo it, or they'll start@reading too much into this.
Are they planning to go to war not only@with us, but with the Gadisword too?!
Honestly, this is a job I don't even need to do.
Could they have timed their attack for@when we made contact with Rabulpaila...?!
This all happened because of Kinaha's@knack for drawing things in...@In a bad way.
Raig-Geios... According to Lieutenant Yon's data,@it's a high-performance mobile weapon for humans.
So there's a human piloting it,@not a bioroid...?!
It'd be troublesome if machines like that were@mass-produced. Though they'd make attractive goods.
Rabulpaila, Hangar
Well, well, you've shown us the Earth military's@strength. Thank you for your assistance.
Allow me to tell you that wasn't@all of our fleet's strength.
Um, Head Chief... If I may be so bold,@I'd like to apologize on behalf@of the <Zovorg>.
No, our home world was not united either.@Different stars, but it's the same everywhere.
Unfortunately, I agree.
But between us, we've managed@to hold a peaceful meeting like this.
Yes. I'll take what I've learned back to the Earth@Federation Government and do my utmost to give@you an answer as soon as possible.
I pray for your safe return, Your Excellency...@But there's one last thing I'd like to ask.
...Head Chief.
I told you I want to hear her reasons from her@directly. This is the Head Chief's decision.
(The fool...)
Let's hear your request, Your Excellency.
It's embarrassing to say... but it seems my bodyguard,@Fairy Klibia, stole a small craft, deserted,@and slipped into Earth.
Why did she do such a thing?
That's unknown. If you take Fairy Klibia into@custody, we would like you to hand her over to us...
Understood.@I'll pass that request on to the Earth@Federation Government as well.
(If the deserter were a spy or saboteur, they@wouldn't ask us so openly to search for her...)
(Then again, even if we take her into custody,@we probably won't just hand her to the Gadisword.)
Well then, Head Chief. We'll take our leave.
Yes, we await a favorable reply from the@Earth Federation Government.
...So those are Earthlings.@They really don't look any different from us.@There were women, too.
There was a theory that if aliens existed,@they'd be like that... It's at a level where@you could say we share the same ancestors.
Even so, that doesn't mean peace will work out.@They could be secretly working with the ones@who attacked us.
But with our current strength, there's no way@we could fight Earth's military.
I know that.@But if the Earthlings bare their fangs at us...
That's what these preliminary talks are for,@to keep that from happening.
We invited them into Rabulpaila and showed@them how things really are.@If they felt like it...
Good work, you two.
Ah, Captain Vort.
In the end, the experimental unit didn't come out...@So Director Herluga had no intention@of showing his hand?
Under the circumstances, it was the best decision.
So Anex's regular army is expendable?
Hey...@You'd better not say things like that here.
I don't care.
Director Herluga is in charge of Rabulpaila.@As long as we can't rejoin our main force,@we have to serve under his command.
Even so, under those Rattma guys...
This is no time to be fighting among ourselves.@If we want to get back to Gadisword, everyone@on Rabulpaila has to work together.
...I know.
By the way, Captain.@What happened with Fairy?
I hear the Head Chief asked the Earthlings@to search for her.
As a deserter?
...Yeah.
(I can't believe Fairy would betray us...)
(She seemed to be brooding over a lot@since Fio died, but there must be@some other reason too...)
Captain, the Commander's shuttle has returned.
Then order the units outside to return as well.@Once all units are aboard, we'll return to Earth@using the Zovorg Transition Route.
Hiryu Custom Hangar
It's been a while, Mr. Former President...@I mean, Your Excellency.
Yes, thanks to you all, I was able to do my job.@You have my gratitude.
Never thought I'd be running into you@on this ship again.
Quite. It seems we're fated to meet.
Who'd have thought a former President of the@Earth Federation Government would be brought out@to negotiate with aliens...
Was it because of your diplomatic skill,@Your Excellency?
Well, who knows?@I never expected to return to the public@stage in a way like this, either...
Oops, I suppose that's not settled yet.
By the way, the meeting with the Gadisword...
That's classified, Lieutenant.@Your Excellency, it's time we went to the bridge.
Ah, right. Well then, everyone... even once@we're back on Earth, please keep it strictly@secret that I was aboard this ship.
...Well, I didn't think we'd get the details@of the meeting out of him that easily.
Too much of this doesn't sit right.
...Malum Quisude seems an honest man,@but he's a poor negotiator.
Even if they're in a position close to refugees,@he played too many of his cards.@Probably because it isn't his profession...
What do you mean?
On planet Gadisword, he was what we'd call a minister,@not a president. But in Rabulpaila, there was no@one else in the line of succession.
So he's an acting president, then?
Yes. Rabulpaila's real leader@is probably Herluga Isberga.
That man seems to be a tricky one.
It may not end there.@He may have known about the <Zovorg>.
I didn't get that impression myself.
When they were told of the Zovorg attack,@Malum Quisude was terribly shaken...
But Herluga Isberga seemed surprised@in a different way. As if he hadn't@expected it.
Something doesn't add up.
Well, quite.
...Sorry to interrupt.@We'll soon be entering the First Phase@of the space transition sequence.
Understood. Let's hope for an uneventful trip home...
